notes: #2–#5 are copies of the same Braun and Hogenberg plate (#3 is a bright modern-looking colored copy; #4’s 1550 date is wrong). #7 has two thin vertical fold creases near the middle (a folded book plate, not a two-page gutter); the picture is continuous. #6 (1702 dealer date) shows the fortress on an invented hill, so skipped. #8 (1894) is a stereo pair with a man in the foreground and the city far off. #9 is a Tibor painting dated only ‘before 1945’. #11 is only about 1070 px wide; its Commons date is the 2007 upload, so dated as a photochrom, 1890s. For P6, #12 and #13 are general panoramas from Ciuperca Hill but distant, hazy and without landmarks.
